verdict.rationale: cubic's own 'Fix with cubic' feature lets a developer delegate a targeted code fix, which cubic generates and pushes as commits to the PR branch. That is a narrow form of hands-off coding-task delegation. Its longer-running modes (Ultrareview, codebase scans) are reviews, not coding tasks, and nothing documents an isolated cloud execution environment. Missing for 10: delegation of general or longer-running coding tasks beyond review-comment fixes, documented isolated/sandboxed cloud execution environments, background task status/monitoring, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment

citations.quote: cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
